content_sections.heading: RUHS Medical Officer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 600 Medical Officer (Medical) posts are to be filled. The category-wise breakup, including the sub-distribution for women candidates (General, Widow, and Deserted/Separated), is given below.

tables.caption: Horizontal Reservation - Persons with Disabilities (4%) and Ex-Servicemen (5%)

content_sections.heading: RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The mandatory qualification is MBBS . As per Personnel Department Notification No. F 03(7)DOP/A-II/97 dated 17 September 1999, candidates must have valid registration with the Rajasthan Medical Council by the date of the written examination. Detailed essential qualification and experience requirements - beyond the MBBS/registration requirement stated above - are not specified in this notification and will be published in the detailed Information Booklet available from 14 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: The notification confirms that pay level and fixed pay details will be included in the detailed Information Booklet, but does not itself state the specific pay figures. These will be available on the RUHS website from 14 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The post is titled a "Direct Recruitment Examination," indicating selection will involve a written examination; however, the detailed selection process, exam pattern, and schedule are not specified in this notification and will be published in the Information Booklet from 14 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official RUHS website: www.ruhsraj.org. From 14 September 2026, download the detailed Information Booklet and review the eligibility, reservation, pay, and exam-schedule details. Complete and submit the online application form between 14 September 2026 and 13 October 2026. The online application form is not yet available as of this notification; candidates are advised to check www.ruhsraj.org regularly for further updates.

faq.question: Q1. What is RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Rajasthan University of Health Sciences for 600 Medical Officer (Medical) posts under the Medical, Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 600 posts in total, distributed across UR, EWS, BC, SC, ST, and MBC categories, with sub-reservation for women and horizontal reservation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q3. When can I apply for RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application form will be available from 14 September 2026 to 13 October 2026 on www.ruhsraj.org. It is not open yet as of this notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MBBS is mandatory, along with valid Rajasthan Medical Council registration by the date of the written examination. Further qualification/experience details will be in the detailed Information Booklet.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Not specified in this notification; expected in the detailed Information Booklet from 14 September 2026.
